promptZh: 读后续写：学校运动会上，你参加 1500 米赛跑并一路领先。最后一圈时，你的好友兼对手林强突然摔倒在地，你停下了脚步。请根据所给段落开头语续写两段，使之构成一篇完整的短文。注意：(1)续写词数应为 150-180 词；(2)请按所给格式分段作答。

explanation.summaryZh: 续写接住摔倒与助人的情节，第二段写赛后的意外反转，主题落在体育精神。
explanation.ruleZh: 读后续写先呼应所给首句，再用动作、对话推进情节，结尾点明主题并与前文呼应。

requirementsZh: 紧扣两段所给开头语续写
情节合理，与前文摔倒助人衔接
使用动作、对话等细节描写
openingSentences: When the race ended, something unexpected happened.
modelAnswer:
I stopped and turned around. Lin Qiang was lying on the track, holding his ankle in pain. For a second, the finish line flashed through my mind, but I ran back and helped him up. 'Can you walk?' I asked. He shook his head, so I put his arm over my shoulder and we moved forward slowly, step by step. The cheers around us grew louder and louder, and some students ran alongside us, calling out our names.

When the race ended, something unexpected happened. We crossed the line last, but the whole stadium stood up and clapped for us. Even the runners who had finished earlier came back to cheer. The headmaster announced that we had won a special prize for sportsmanship, which had never been given before. Lin Qiang hugged me and said, 'You gave up the gold medal for me.' I smiled and shook my head. True victory, I have learned, is not always about being the first one to cross the finish line.
